_about: The effects the original's script ADDS - entities spawned by name with AddEntity - as each call
adds its one: which .ent, where from the point the call is given, at what depth, turned how and
at what scale. The call site's facts only: what the entity itself is (its sprite, its particle
systems, its light, its own <Scale>) is read from the original's .ent at run time by
Art::LoadEnt and never copied here, since hand copies of the fifty-odd files would drift.
Decoded from android_game.bin through the remake's asbc listing (out/parity/asbc/
all_functions.txt, md5 48fe65ce8baea16b94ed84d8d7be84b0). Step 91 of
docs/planning/2026-09-11-magic-portals-remaster.md (the visuals plan's 6.2, system_7 7a-1).
WHAT IS HERE. The rows of vanishEffect and appearEffect (Portal.angelscript), whose
arithmetic test_mp_effects pins: the teleport's three effects, drawn by the visuals plan's
step 7.3. Every other effect the script adds gets its row with the step that draws it, so a
missing row is an effect not yet drawn, not one the script lacks. What reads a row is
sim/Effects, strictly: every field below is required.
UNITS. AddEntity(file, vector3(xy, z), angle, @out, altName, scale), its arguments pushed
last-first (00_order 8.0 rule 3; ETHScriptWrapper.Scene.cpp:131-158). The script's
g_scale.scale(n) is n x screenHeight / 256 (00_order 8.12a), which is n of the port's units,
so offset_units and a z whose `scaled` is true are those n. A z the call writes as a bare
literal is in the engine's own units and does not grow with the screen (00_order 8.12b):
`scaled` false says so; the port, whose unit is one level unit, reads the number as it is.
`scale` is a multiple of g_scale.getScale(), the script's scale for anything it adds at its
own size, which is 1 in the port's units; the entity is drawn at that times its .ent's
<Scale> (Art::Entity::ScaleAt). `angle` is Ethanon's, in degrees, counter-clockwise on the
screen: a number, or the named rule toward_traveller_minus_90, radianToDegree(getAngle(d)) -
90 with d = normalize(traveller - portal) and getAngle(v) = atan2f(v.x, v.y) wrapped into
[0, 2 pi) (GameMath.h:711-715), computed in floats as the script computes it.

_source: explosion.ent is an .ent of the original's that nothing adds: the listing holds no string
'explosion.ent' (its explosion names are 'explosion_large.ent', 'small_explosion.ent',
'small_explosion_no_light.ent' and 'antiportal_explosion.ent'), and no level places it -
no <EntityName> or custom-data value of any of the 133 .esc files names it. A barrel's
blast is explode()'s explosion_large.ent (MiscCallbacks, bytes 342023..342895, #23;
ETHCallback_barrel_bomb #56-60), which is what the plan's 7e row 'explosion.ent /
explosion_large.ent on barrel detonations' should read (system_7 S10).
vanishEffect (Portal.angelscript, bytes 356384..356958), called with the traveller's
position before it moves and the entry portal's: #2-13 direction = normalize(objectPos -
portalPos) (normalize of a zero vector is zero, GameMath.h:755-761); #14-26 offset =
direction x g_scale.scale(32); #28-34 angle = radianToDegree(getAngle(direction)) - 90;
#36-69 AddEntity('suck_effect.ent', vector3(portalPos + offset, g_scale.scale(32)),
angle, @effect, '', g_scale.getScale()). Its callers: PortalManager::teleportToOther
(bytes 144944..145873) #61, before #69 moves the traveller;
PortalManager::teleportToFirstStaticPortal (145999..146550) #44;
ETHCallback_portal_static (360571..361404) #144; and LoadingScreen::loop
(178170..179373) #241 - the loading screen, which ui.json's loading.vanish reads with
the same 32 and -90 (test_mp_effects pins that the two agree).
vanishEffect #83-112: AddEntity('sparkles.ent', vector3(objectPos, g_scale.scale(32)),
angle, @effect, '', g_scale.getScale()) - at the traveller where it stood, turned as the
suck effect is (#93 pushes the same local). #100-101: VAR objectPos then GETOBJREF 0,
which names the stack slot VAR just filled, not the portal (00_order 8.0 rule 1).
appearEffect (Portal.angelscript, bytes 357060..357278), called with the exit portal's
position once the traveller stands there (teleportToOther #71-75, after #69):
AddEntity('appear_effect.ent', vector3(pos, 2), 0, @effect, '', g_scale.getScale()) -
#12 the angle 0, #13 the z 2, a bare literal (PshC4 2f, not through g_scale.scale). The
same pair of calls ends teleportToFirstStaticPortal (#44, #58) and ETHCallback_portal_static
Beholder's spawnStone (bytes 373491..373647) adds the same .ent at a rock another way,
AddScaledEntity('appear_effect.ent', vector3(pos, 0), g_scale.scale(1.5)) (#5-22): z 0
and scale 1.5, a row of its own for the step that draws the rocks' effect.
